t: Reduce fear.
Earn trust before the first click.
Help tired readers finish.
Stop wasted mornings.
Make the next bus obvious.
Prove every answer.
Keep strange records alive.
Bring people back on bad days.
Nobody gets lost.
Make saving feel possible.
Readers need a large serif body so that their eyes settle on the letters.
Frightened patients should see a calm blue header on every page they open.
People who visit want a dark teal background behind the product photos.
Students need the balance shown in the biggest type on the screen.
Customers have to see rounded cards with a soft shadow when they arrive.
Parents should be able to see bright primary colours across the whole app.
Farmers need wide margins around each machine photo on their phones.
Visitors should notice a slow fade whenever someone moves between images.
Customers need their pages served from a CDN so that engineers can deploy twice a day.
Readers should get the timetable from a cache that our team refreshes each night.
People have to receive a push notification that a scheduled job sends each morning.
Designers need a shared component library they can publish from a monorepo.
